TWGoK OVA, TWGoK: Tenri Arc, TWGoK: Goddesses 1+2+12 Episodes

The OVAs were fine, mostly a setup for the third season. The third season was a surprise tho. The anime changed a lot, stopped being about conquest&forget and became a much more complex task for Keima. And god, he deserves to be called a god for the most part of it. He's smooth as fuck. I just wish the ending was a bit more conclusive.

JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders 17-21/24 Episodes

Slowly progressing on it. I can't binge watch this, but it's amazing how funny and ridiculous this anime can be even on a slightly modified monster-of-the-week type of format. Unfortunately it saddens me the new JoJo doesn't talk that much. His grandpa on the previous anime was so much better ;_;

Akame ga Kill 1-24/24 Episodes

Starts somewhat interesting and an average world but it's too full of shounen tropes. Very "edgy". Tries too hard to provoke anger and show the watcher how fucked up is the world but IMO, it fails at it. I can't take the setting seriously. Most of the characters are uninteresting and their character designs aren't anything special. Past the mid point of the series it starts to get very boring as it's noticeable it's getting to a shitty finale. I was really disappointed with this one. It even failed at getting me interested in the manga. If someone watched the anime and read the manga, please tell me how much it differs.

Saishuu Heiki Kanojo 1-13/13 Episodes

I went into it expecting it to be boring and it surprised me. It's too sad, too depressing and at the same time too good. I really liked this and was so close to give it a 10/10. I wish I could watch something like this with less focus on romance and more modern.

Minami-ke 1-13/13 Episodes

This type of Slice of Life is not my thing, but I really liked Minami-ke. The comedy was really good most of the time and it was amazing every time a certain character that started crossdressing appeared. The dynamic between the sisters was interesting.

Girls und Panzer 1-12/12 Episodes

Girls und Panzer was surprisingly good for the kind of show it seemed to be. I was expecting some SoL with minimal tank action but I got lots of tank action with minimal SoL. It saddens me it was so short but thankfully there's a movie coming and I still need to watch the OVA.

Ao Haru Ride 1-12/12 Episodes

I usually like shoujo anime a lot but this one disappointed me. It started really good but in the end it goes nowhere. No romantic conclusion at all ;_; Maybe it needed more episodes. I liked the characters and their designs but the way it ends just makes me sad.

On the previous week I had problems deciding what to watch, this one I got myself into way too much stuff and struggled quite a bit to finish what I picked up.

I was getting pretty annoyed with having to watch video Ads on my Roku.
After a little research and trial and error it seems all you have to do is have a little knowledge of your routers block list. The two domains I've blocked (remember to power cycle your roku once you've made your changes)

  • doubleclick.net
  • zedo.com

It's not a complete solution as there are still a few non video ads that get through but to me that's not bad at all anymore.

In trouble shooting I found that

  • SlingTv needs api.roku.com
  • YouTube needs cloudservices.roku.com
  • ChanelStore needs cloudservices.roku.com

Tested on TP-Link brand router and Roku3
